name: Deathcraft
source:
This city on the bank of the sea is rich with resources and population. Renovation project creates a lot of inorganic buildings, neon lights and a railway line.
Devils manipulating minds with witchcraft and preying on humans start to be seen in this city. As rumors spread, population flees and railway line gets closed.
Now this city is a playground for demon hunters looking for vicious criminals.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这座海边城市资源丰富，人口众多。改造项目创造了许多无机建筑、霓虹灯和铁路线。
这座城市开始出现用巫术操纵心灵、捕食人类的恶魔。随着谣言的传播，人们纷纷逃离，铁路线被关闭。
现在这座城市是恶魔猎人寻找恶毒罪犯的游乐场。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
